info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Update API enables users to modify details of external agencies based on a specified identifier. This API provides a streamlined approach for updating important information related to various external entities involved in syndicate management. Typical consumers include financial institutions and compliance teams looking to ensure accurate and up-to-date agency data. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently manage and refine external agency records, supporting enhanced operational efficiency and data integrity.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the Syndicate Management resource with the ID 100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields in the request body to successfully modify the existing resource.

requestBody.description: This PATCH request is used to update the syndicate management details for the specified external agency. The request payload should contain the fields that need to be modified, following the schema definition. Ensure to include only the fields that you wish to update.

200.description: Request completed successfully, data has been updated.
